message.subject: Re: Question
message.body: Approve fail-closed acknowledgement for any retention form not yet proven by observed receipts. Do not invent an explicit worker-retain shape or call it just to manufacture evidence; the user has not requested keeping a new test worker. Document the exact supported cleanup forms (verified release, verified live reuse, observed user_owned/user_takeover) and the retained/pre-existing/explicit-retain live gate still pending. This is a limitation, not a false success; global migration stays blocked until relevant live gates pass. Also consume the two-edge review message sent just before this reply (stale generation must throw, attach must inspect owner before run-use, pre-aborted signal must not launch). Finish steps2–5 as an implementation candidate with these limits, run check/tests and commit only your isolated worktree. Report exact unresolved live cases, not whole-plan completion.
